2RBI Grade B Phase 1 General Awareness Recollected Questions RBI Grade B 2026 Phase 1 - General Awareness Recollected Questions Q.1) The Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) model has become important in governance because it allows governments to deliver digital services at scale. What is the key significance of the DPI model? [A] It replaces all private digital platforms with government-owned platforms [B] It creates open, interoperable and inclusive digital systems for public service delivery [C] It is used only for international trade settlement [D] It focuses only on cybersecurity for defense networks [E] It removes the role of financial institutions from digital payments Q.2) As of May 2026, which of the following countries is a current member of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)? [A] Vietnam [B] Brazil [C] Saudi Arabia [D] UAE [E] Philippines Q.3) India signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) in December 2025 with which of the following country? [A] Oman [B] United Arab Emirates [C] Australia [D] Mauritius [E] Indonesia Q.4) On May 18, 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred the prestigious Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit by His Majesty King Harald V in which of the following city? [A] Stockholm [B] Copenhagen [C] Helsinki [D] Oslo [E] Reykjavik

3RBI Grade B Phase 1 General Awareness Recollected Questions Q.5) In India, Goods and Services Tax (GST) Day is observed every year on which date? [A] 1 April [B] 1 March [C] 31 August [D] 2 October [E] 1 July Q.6) The International Day of Yoga is observed every year to promote the physical, mental and spiritual benefits of yoga. On which date is it celebrated? [A] 21 March [B] 5 June [C] 21 June [D] 12 August [E] 10 December Q.7) Which Indian cricketer became the co-owner of Dublin Guardians, a team in the European T20 Premier League (ETPL)? [A] M S Dhoni [B] Virat Kohli [C] Sourav Ganguly [D] Rahul Dravid [E] Yuvraj Singh Q.8) Vijay Ghat in New Delhi is the memorial associated with which Indian personality? [A] Lal Bahadur Shastri [B] Jawaharlal Nehru [C] Mahatma Gandhi [D] Indira Gandhi [E] Atal Bihari Vajpayee Q.9) The term Brexit in context of United Kingdom refers to which of the following? [A] The withdrawal of the United Kingdom from NATO [B] The withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the Schengen Area [C] The withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the European Union [D] The withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the G20 [E] The withdrawal of the United Kingdom from the G7

It is one of the highest civilian awards of India. 2. The selection committee is headed by President of India. 3. A person can self nominate himself/herself for the award. [A] Coins issued after the introduction of the decimal system in 1957 [B] Currency arrangements during the transition period from 1947 to 1950 [C] Gold coins issued during the British period [D] Commemorative coins issued after 1975 [E] Coins issued only for collectors and not for circulation

22RBI Grade B Phase 1 General Awareness Recollected Questions What Next? 1. Identify Right Source: Follow the best study resources (books, online courses, videos, etc.) for each topic on the list. Do not follow multiple sources for the same topic but rather follow good sources multiple times. 2. Topic Prioritization: Review the document to identify key topics that require special attention. Prioritize your study schedule based on the significance of each topic in the syllabus. Ensure a balanced approach, allocating more time to critical subjects. 3. Width of Syllabus: Merely going through the syllabus is not enough; Regularly revisit the document to reassess what topics actually need to be covered. 4. Depth of Understanding: Recognize the varying depths at which topics should be covered. While some concepts demand a broad understanding, others require a more in-depth analysis. Tailor your study approach, accordingly, allocating more time to complex topics that demand deeper comprehension.
